sentence: This project studies the role of the autonomic nervous system in cardiac arrhythmias, using non-invasive neuromodulation in patients.
This project uses an animal model of alcohol self-administration to study how synaptic changes in the prefrontal cortex lead to compulsive alcohol drinking.
This project uses color variation in animals and knockout mice to find genes that interact with a transmembrane protease and to learn what it does.
This project builds a computational and experimental framework to analyze spatial metabolomics and spatial transcriptomics together in tissue, looking at drug resistance.
This project studies how de novo nucleotide synthesis in endothelial cells is linked to atherosclerosis.
This project looks for small, drug-like molecules that activate a delta opioid receptor and kappa opioid receptor heteromer in pain-sensing neurons.
This project develops an artificial intelligence algorithm and magnetic resonance neurography to diagnose occipital neuralgia and predict treatment outcome.
This project tests whether working with soft growing flexible robots, instead of rigid ones, leads to more trust, fewer safety hazards and less stress.
This project looks for leukocyte RNA biomarkers linked to dystonia and studies the role of one biomarker in how the disorder develops.
This project builds computational tools to predict protein-ligand interactions in signaling networks and uses them to study how human cell signaling varies.
This project builds a framework to weigh the benefits and risks of glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists in children with obesity and type 2 diabetes.
This project studies the neuronal mechanisms of auditory temporal pattern processing using natural communication signals.
This project develops a method to find antimicrobial resistance genes and the pathogens that carry them in metagenomic data.
This project uses the fruit fly to study the molecular causes of Pontocerebellar Hypoplasia Type 1b, an inherited neurological disorder.
This project studies how sterile acute kidney injury leads to worse respiratory failure and inflammation in other organs.
This project studies how fungal and bacterial pathogens interact during catheter-associated urinary tract infections.
This project studies how the Drosophila intestine balances urgent repair against a longer-term return to homeostasis after injury.
This project studies how proteome and phosphoproteome turnover changes in brain regions and cell types during Alzheimer's disease.
This project uses computational methods to model the motions of drug receptors and artificial intelligence models to search for drugs.
This project applies a dual-layer x-ray detector to measure coronary artery calcium from chest x-rays.
